_comment: Registry of monitored cron jobs. cron_heartbeat.py checks each one for liveness (did it fire within max_age_hours?) and health (did its log contain an error signature?). Add a row whenever you add a cron in crontab.example. 'log' is relative to _scripts/ops/logs/. 'beat' is the optional explicit success-heartbeat name (ops/logs/heartbeat/<beat>.txt); when present it takes precedence over log mtime. Set 'critical' false for non-essential jobs (warning instead of error on staleness).
